rule: When a deep carry-chain path (≥12 levels, CARRY4 cells ≥6) implements a multi-operand addition (≥3 addends) in a single carry-ripple tree, replace with a carry-save adder (CSA) tree that reduces to two operands before the final carry-propagate add, keeping all register boundaries identical.
applies_when: Path contains CARRY4 ≥6 AND logic depth ≥12 AND the timed addition combines ≥3 distinct 32-bit operands (here: h_reg + sum1 + ch + w_data + k_data = 5 operands feeding t1, then t1+t2 = 2-operand final add for a_new) AND route% < 70% (logic-bound, so logic restructuring helps) AND no pipeline register may be inserted
expected_effect: CSA tree collapses five-operand t1 sum and subsequent t1+t2 into two carry-propagate stages of roughly half the carry-chain depth, reducing the critical path from ~16 logic levels to ~8-10 levels with no latency change

evidence.declined_by_menu: The binding path is a 16-level carry-chain arithmetic path through the SHA-256 round function (t1+t2 → a_reg), and none of the menu strategies have their preconditions met: route% is below 70% (no max_fanout_16), no flag/decode comparison (no flag_precompute), no sign-extract idiom (no sign_select), 32-bit domain (no constant_lut), and no variable shifter (no shifter_mux_reduce).
